accountKey.title: Account Key
accountKey.description: Salesforce Account name or record id. Used only by Apex to collect aggregate revenue facts.

accountName.title: Account Name
accountName.description: Optional Salesforce Account name. Used only to find the Account and not sent to the external AI API.

recordId.title: Record Id
recordId.description: Optional Salesforce Account record id from the current record context.

requestId.title: Request Id
requestId.description: Optional safe correlation id for backend telemetry. Do not use Salesforce record ids.
